# Stalak

> Stalak (https://stalak.app) is a free, browser-based lip-sync video editor for rappers and singers. Upload your song and a few takes of you performing it; Stalak cuts between the takes on the beat, keeps the lip sync tight, adds on-screen lyrics and exports for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or a full 16:9 YouTube music video. It runs in the browser on iPhone, Android or desktop. English and French.

Stalak is not related to the Dofus game creature of the same name.

## Main pages
- [Stalak (English)](https://stalak.app/en/): the editor, with "What is Stalak?" explaining the product.
- [Stalak (French)](https://stalak.app/): the same app in French.
- [Pricing (English)](https://stalak.app/en/pricing): Free, Stalak Pro and Creator Plus.
- [Pricing (French)](https://stalak.app/tarifs): the same in French.

## Facts
- No download and no sign-up: Stalak runs in the browser. The free plan needs no account.
- Free: unlimited videos; auto cuts on the beat, on every word or every bar; on-screen lyrics one line at a time (size M), pasted in and synced by tapping; 3 filters (Frost, 35mm Film, Black & White); vertical 9:16 export. Free videos carry a small Stalak logo watermark that moves to a new spot now and then; watching a ~30-second ad removes it from that video.
- Stalak Pro ($7.99/month or $49.99/year): no ads, no watermark, 16:9 music video mode, premium effects, word-by-word and karaoke lyrics in any size, all filters, auto lyrics written and synced from your vocals.
- Creator Plus ($14.99/month or $99.99/year): everything in Pro, plus video packs (5 to 30 differently cut videos from one song, from just 2 takes), automatic cloud saving, and "Talk to a human" (live chat, or an email reply within 24 hours).
- Prices are in US dollars; any sales tax or VAT is added at checkout. Subscribers keep their price.
- Payments are handled by Paddle. Full refund within 14 days.
- Made by 99Sayso, a rapper from the Alaska collective, who coded Stalak for his own videos.
- Contact: contact@stalak.app
